description: 20 penetration testing training labs with Active Directory and intentional vulnerabilities

easy_tier.name: AD-WS-Easy-1
easy_tier.description: Weak AD password policy allows credential brute force attacks. Min 4 chars, 999-day expiration.
easy_tier.exploitation: Enumerate users via LDAP, perform password spraying or dictionary attacks

easy_tier.name: AD-WS-Easy-2
easy_tier.vulnerability: Default service accounts with high privileges
easy_tier.description: Service accounts with known/weak passwords running with SYSTEM privileges
easy_tier.exploitation: Identify service running as service account, exploit with captured credentials

easy_tier.name: AD-WS-Easy-3
easy_tier.vulnerability: Unpatched system with known public exploits
easy_tier.description: Windows Server 2022 with known CVE (e.g., PrintSpooler, SMBv3)
easy_tier.exploitation: Use public exploit (e.g., CVE-2021-1732) to gain SYSTEM privileges

easy_tier.name: AD-WS-Easy-4
easy_tier.vulnerability: IIS basic auth over HTTP (credential capture)
easy_tier.description: IIS with basic authentication over unencrypted HTTP. Credentials in Base64.
easy_tier.exploitation: Capture HTTP traffic via MITM, Base64 decode credentials

easy_tier.name: AD-WS-Easy-5
easy_tier.description: SMB shares with overly permissive access (Everyone:Read, Users:Modify on sensitive shares)
easy_tier.exploitation: Enumerate shares with net view, access confidential files, find credentials

easy_tier.name: AD-WS-Easy-6
easy_tier.description: User stored RunAs credentials, UAC not properly configured, registry-readable LAPS password
easy_tier.exploitation: Extract RunAs credentials from process memory or registry, bypass UAC via trusted binary

medium_tier.name: AD-WS-Medium-1
medium_tier.vulnerability: ASP.NET SQL injection in IIS webapp
medium_tier.description: Custom ASP.NET login form vulnerable to SQL injection. Time-based blind SQLi exploitable.
medium_tier.exploitation: Perform SQL injection to extract users/passwords, use second-order injection for RCE

medium_tier.name: AD-WS-Medium-2
medium_tier.description: Service account configured with constrained delegation to sensitive service. Allows S4U2Self + S4U2Proxy
medium_tier.exploitation: Capture service ticket, use S4U2Self, perform constrained delegation to escalate

medium_tier.name: AD-WS-Medium-3
medium_tier.description: Service accounts with SPNs set and weak passwords. AS-REP roasting not prevented.
medium_tier.exploitation: Request service tickets, crack offline via Hashcat. OR request AS-REP ticket for user without preauth

medium_tier.name: AD-WS-Medium-4
medium_tier.vulnerability: IIS directory traversal + web shell upload
medium_tier.description: IIS directory traversal vulnerability in file viewer + unsafe file upload in separate app
medium_tier.exploitation: Use path traversal to read system files, upload web shell via second app, execute commands

medium_tier.name: AD-WS-Medium-5
medium_tier.description: Group Policy allows users to run elevated tasks (e.g., scheduled task). RunAs credentials cached.
medium_tier.exploitation: Identify writable task or registry via GPO, modify to run malicious command as SYSTEM

medium_tier.name: AD-WS-Medium-6
medium_tier.vulnerability: LDAP injection in custom IIS application
medium_tier.description: IIS application takes user input and builds LDAP queries without sanitization
medium_tier.exploitation: Perform LDAP injection to enumerate users, modify filter to extract credential hashes

medium_tier.name: AD-WS-Medium-7
medium_tier.description: Application runs as elevated user and can be exploited for token theft. Impersonation privileges enabled.
medium_tier.exploitation: Exploit vulnerable process to steal SYSTEM token, spawn shell with elevated privileges

hard_tier.name: AD-WS-Hard-1
hard_tier.description: Kernel vulnerability (CVE-2019-1132 or similar) combined with service misconfiguration
hard_tier.exploitation: Exploit kernel vuln for initial high priv, then pivot via service misconfig to SYSTEM

hard_tier.name: AD-WS-Hard-2
hard_tier.description: SMB signing disabled on network, NTLM v1 in use, relay attack possible to sensitive services
hard_tier.exploitation: Perform NTLM relay via HTTP->LDAP or HTTP->SMB to escalate via LDAP or modify files via SMB

hard_tier.name: AD-WS-Hard-3
hard_tier.description: AD objects with misconfigured ACLs (e.g., user can WriteProperty on admin account userAccountControl)
hard_tier.exploitation: Use BloodHound to find ACL path, exploit WriteProperty to set userAccountControl flags for privilege escalation

hard_tier.name: AD-WS-Hard-4
hard_tier.vulnerability: IIS WebDAV + HTTP PUT method exploitation
hard_tier.description: IIS with WebDAV enabled, HTTP PUT allowed, directories writable, no input validation
hard_tier.exploitation: Use WebDAV PUT to upload malicious .aspx file, execute arbitrary code as IIS application pool identity

hard_tier.name: AD-WS-Hard-5
hard_tier.vulnerability: DLL injection + COM elevation of privilege
hard_tier.description: Writable directory in DLL LoadPath, COM object execution via CLSID allows elevation
hard_tier.exploitation: Craft malicious DLL, place in LoadPath, trigger COM object instantiation for code execution as elevated user

hard_tier.name: AD-WS-Hard-6
hard_tier.description: Service account with impersonate privileges can forge its own Kerberos tickets
hard_tier.exploitation: Use service account to request S4U2Self ticket, forge admin impersonation, gain domain admin privileges

hard_tier.name: AD-WS-Hard-7
hard_tier.description: Staged payload delivery combined with persistence via scheduled task, registry, or WMI event subscription
hard_tier.exploitation: Deploy multi-stage payload, establish persistence via multiple mechanisms, detect and remove all stages
